[[Seagoville, Texas]] | draft = | draft_year = 2006 | draft_team = | career_start = | former_teams = | awards = }} '''LaMarcus Aldridge''' (born [[July 19]], [[1985]] in [[Dallas, Texas|Dallas, Texas]]) is a 6'11" (2.11 m) [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]], currently a [[sophomore]] at the [[University of Texas at Austin|University of Texas]]. On [[April 11]], [[2006]], Aldridge announced that he would leave the University of Texas to enter the [[2006 NBA Draft]]. Aldridge is currently projected to be a top five pick, and some have speculated that Aldridge will be the #1 pick by the Toronto Raptors.
